newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish c.bank head says credit growth too fast - PAP.
newsitem.headline: Polish c.bank head says credit growth too fast - PAP.

text.p: National Bank of Poland (NBP) President Hanna Gronkiewicz-Waltz said on Friday that the central bank continued to be concerned by faster than desired growth in credit, PAP news agency reported.

"It is unacceptable that this growth was 108 percent against last year and the growth in January alone reached the 2.5 billion zloty level," PAP quoted Gronkiewicz-Waltz as saying at a banking forum in the port city of Szczecin.
She said that in order to slash inflation to 13 percent at the end of this year, monthly growth in consumer credit should not exceed one billion zlotys.

Since the start of the last quarter of 1996 the central bank has signalled its concern over fast credit expansion and from the beginning of this month increased mandatory reserves on zloty call deposits and currency deposits to contain monetary expansion.
